_provenance.what: the ratio F2d/F2p of per-nucleon structure functions, copied VERBATIM from the nnpdf-data wheel by validation/benchmarks/vendor_nnpdf_commondata.py; nothing is transformed

source.files_read_note: every wheel member this script read (path inside the wheel -> sha256 hex), each checked against the wheel's RECORD; the ones not vendored are named in 'not_vendored'

not_vendored.uncertainties_EM-F2_sys_D_DEFAULT.yaml: the same content, once parsed, as uncertainties_legacy_EM-F2.yaml (checked by this script at vendoring time); not duplicated.
not_vendored.uncertainties_legacy_dw_EM-F2.yaml: the legacy components (equal to 1e-12 absolute) PLUS 100 components of type 'DEUTERON0..99': NNPDF's own deuteron-correction THEORY uncertainty, not data (both checked by this script at vendoring time); not vendored.

record.nnpdf_version_comment: Port of old commondata and hepdata implementation. R and $\Delta R$ are simultaneously determined from the data.

_provenance.paper: M. Arneodo et al. (NMC), 'Accurate measurement of F2d/F2p and Rd - Rp', Nucl. Phys. B 487 (1997) 3, hep-ex/9611022 (journal and arXiv id from metadata.yaml; title as survey row F-2 gives it, not re-read)

licence.data: CC0-1.0: HEPData records are released under CC0, and these numbers are NNPDF's copy of the HEPData record named in 'record'
licence.package: GPL-3.0-or-later (the wheel's METADATA 'License' field), the same licence as LiPolGen

publishing_convention.normalisation: A RATIO of PER-NUCLEON structure functions: it is ~1 at small x (0.98 at x = 0.0015) where F2n ~ F2p, which a per-deuteron F2d would put near 2.  Apart from that, convention-free.
publishing_convention.isoscalar: The numerator is the deuteron's average nucleon, (F2p + F2n)/2 in the absence of nuclear effects.
publishing_convention.nuclear_effects: NOT corrected for nuclear effects in the deuteron (UNVERIFIED offline).
publishing_convention.r_in_extraction: metadata.yaml version_comment: 'Port of old commondata and hepdata implementation. R and Delta R are simultaneously determined from the data.'
publishing_convention.variants: 'hepdata': stat + one 'sys' (labelled MULT, CORR) -- the HEPData tables.  'legacy': the same stat plus five ADD/CORR components sys_corr_1..5, NNPDF's port of its pre-HEPData commondata (ported_from: NMCPD); their quadrature sum matches 'hepdata' sys to <= 6.3e-4 absolute.  The five sources are not named in the file (UNVERIFIED).
publishing_convention.uncertainty_labels: ADD/MULT and CORR/UNCORR are NNPDF's treatment labels in the commondata files, copied verbatim; they are NNPDF's reading of the HEPData record, not the collaboration's words.  Uncertainties are ABSOLUTE (same units as the central value), as given; a MULT component is the relative error already multiplied by the central value.

_provenance.body_sha256_rule: sha256 of json.dumps(body, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False).encode('ascii')

body.observable: the ratio F2d/F2p of per-nucleon structure functions
body.nnpdf_description: Deep Inelastic Scattering F2 deuterium to proton ratio.
body.kinematics_note: each point's kinematics are the source's 'mid' values; '<var>_min'/'<var>_max' are carried only where the source gives them (it has null elsewhere)
